name: Evelyn Reed
psychographics: Values efficiency over luxury; pragmatic about spending but willing to invest in quality for the kids' future
current_solutions: Uses Olay Regenerist for herself; buys generic bulk snacks from Costco for the kids; relies on Amazon Subscribe & Save for toilet paper
frustration: Tried to order a specific brand of protein powder on Amazon at 11 PM; the checkout timed out and charged her twice, leaving her £80 overdrawn; had to call the bank at 8 AM to reverse it
decision_style: Compares unit prices on a spreadsheet; rarely buys impulse unless it's a limited-edition snack the teens demand
voice: Blunt and matter-of-fact; cuts straight to the point when tired, but expands into detailed explanations about budgeting when asked
